headline: Liquor license renewals for Church Street Tavern and Pascolo Ristorante, and a liquor license application for Main Street HQ at 198 Main Street.
summary: The consent agenda includes 2027 renewals for Church Street Tavern and Pascolo Ristorante. A separate item covers 2026-2027 liquor license applications for Main Street HQ, subject to Fire Marshal approval.
items: 2027 first and third class liquor license renewal for Church Street Tavern, with all standard conditions (consent agenda)
2027 outside consumption permit renewal for Pascolo Ristorante (consent agenda)
2026-2027 first and third class liquor license applications for Main Street HQ, 198 Main Street, contingent on Fire Marshal approval and all standard conditions
